description: Two-peer version_metadata exchange.  Each side sends its 'meta' preamble + signed handshake body, the other side verifies the ed25519 signature over blake2b-keyed(password)(pubkey), and both end up with peer pubkeys.  This is the first frame any peer link exchanges.  Then A sends a router sig_req -- A wants B to sign A's tree position so A can adopt B as parent.

frames.comment: A's handshake meta.  Layout: 4-byte 'meta' preamble + uint16 BE body length + TLV body (major+minor+pubkey+priority) + 64-byte ed25519 signature.  Signature is over blake2b-keyed(empty_password)(A_pubkey).
B's handshake reply -- same layout, B's pubkey, B's ed25519 signature.  Both sides may send concurrently; the order in this scenario is canonical-A-first but the protocol doesn't care.

RouterSigReq(seq=1, nonce=0x12345678).  Body is varint(seq) + varint(nonce).  Type byte = WIRE_PROTO_SIG_REQ = 2.  Triggers B's handle_sig_req which constructs + signs a sig_res with port=A's port at B.

name: handshake_then_sig_req
